answer: In an agent economy selling violet pigment, umber paint, and trellis designs, every seller identity must lock a $100 bond to open one bidding slot, held until 30 days after its last delivery. Creating names is cheap, but creating 1,000 active sellers immobilizes $100,000: the attacker pays financing costs and loses access to that capital during the lockup. Sybils remain possible, but each usable identity carries the same economic burden.
